name: Pull requests for data in Grist

mentions.name: Pull requests for data in Grist
mentions.description: This feature adds pull-request-style workflows for data to the Grist spreadsheet, enabling data diffs, patches, and reviews so people working on curated data projects can collaborate more like coders.
mentions.problem: Curated data projects lack a coder-like workflow with pull requests and reviews, and building such a workflow as a stand-alone tool was too much.
mentions.audience: People working on data projects, especially curated data projects
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm quietly adding "pull requests" for data to Grist https://github.com/gristlabs/grist-core/issues/1829 - been wanting to do this for a long time.
